app.name: Wii-Fi Tester
app.long_description: Probes an internally installed Wii WLAN module directly through Hollywood SDIO1 using an adaptive, bounded bring-up sequence, validates CMD52/CMD53, and enumerates the BCM4318 SSB backplane. Produces stage-specific diagnostics and saves its report to SD or USB. It does not use the IOS WLAN driver, install or replace IOS, or write NAND. Direct hardware access is required.
